gizmo.title: Arithmetic drill
gizmo.description: A short run of generated arithmetic problems with instant feedback. Pick the operations and the number range; every run is new.

configure.title: Title
configure.description: Name of this drill, shown in its header.

configure.title: Operations
configure.description: Which kinds of problems are asked. Learners can switch any of these off before they start.

configure.title: Smallest number
configure.description: The smallest number used in a problem. Whole numbers, 0 or more.

configure.title: Largest number
configure.description: The largest number used in a problem. Division answers and divisors stay in this range too.

configure.title: Number of problems
configure.description: How many problems are in one run (1 to 100).

advanced.title: Time limit
advanced.description: Seconds allowed for a whole run. 0 means no timer, which is the default: timed drills fail learners who need more time. When set, learners can still turn the timer off for themselves.

advanced.title: Accent color
advanced.description: Color of the header chip and buttons. Leave empty to follow the theme.
